name: Lumbar Facet Synovial Cyst
definition: Degenerative synovial cyst arising from a lumbar facet joint that may narrow the canal or foramen and compress a nerve root.

investigations.principle: MRI demonstrates cyst and neural compression; CT can define facet degeneration/calcification.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Conservative management for stable mild symptoms
amber: Persistent severe radiculopathy, instability or deficit may require injection or decompression.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kati/Vata-radicular phenotype may be documented in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Degenerative synovial cyst arising from a lumbar facet joint that may narrow the canal or foramen and compress a nerve root.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
